label: Best months
value: June to September, stated for Shahi Bagh, not for the lake
quote: the best time to visit Shahi Bagh is from June to September.
source: Lovin Pakistan, Shahi Bagh guide (undated; fetched Oct 2026)

label: Distance from Utror and Shahi Bagh
value: About 31 km from Utror and 20 km from Shahi Bagh, by the sources. The OSM track ends about 9 km in a straight line from the lake, so the sources' distances do not match the map.
quote: It is approximately 31 kilometers from Utror and 20 kilometers from Shahi Bagh.
source: Nature Adventure Club, Swat lakes (undated; fetched Oct 2026)

label: Walk from Shahi Bagh
value: About 10 hours on foot from Shahi Bagh (Nature Adventure Club). Dawn (Aug 2021) describes a night in tents at Jabba pasture, then about seven hours of hard climbing.
quote: To reach Mushroom Lake from Shahi Bagh, you will need to trek for about 10 hours.

label: Night at Jabba pasture
value: Dawn's route: along the river from Shahi Bagh to Jabba pasture, a night in tents, then an early start for the lake.
quote: where they have to spend a night in tents
source: Dawn, "A jewel hidden in barren mountains of Swat", 16 Aug 2021

label: Getting to Shahi Bagh
value: Four-wheel drive only to Shahi Bagh (Traveler Trails). Lovin Pakistan gives a 4-hour jeep drive to it.
quote: Shahi Bagh is only accessible through a four-wheel-drive vehicle.
source: Traveler Trails, Shahi Bagh (undated; fetched Oct 2026)

label: How hard the walk is
value: Called one of the toughest and hardest treks in the valley (Dawn, 2021)
quote: the trek is one of the toughest and hardest treks in the valley
source: Dawn, "A jewel hidden in barren mountains of Swat", 16 Aug 2021

label: Winter
value: Shahi Bagh is enveloped in snow from September to June (Lovin Pakistan)
quote: is enveloped in snow from September till June
source: Lovin Pakistan, Shahi Bagh guide (undated; fetched Oct 2026)

label: Altitude (sources differ)
value: About 13,500 ft (about 4,115 m) per Nature Adventure Club; the model's lake surface reads 4,076 m, a gap of about 39 m
quote: The lake is situated at an elevation of approximately 13,500 feet above sea level
source: Nature Adventure Club, Swat lakes (undated; fetched Oct 2026)
